# Earth.Org

> Earth.Org is an environmental news and education platform dedicated to empowering youth with knowledge about climate change, wildlife conservation, and sustainable living.

Earth.Org Kids delivers accessible environmental journalism and educational content for younger audiences, covering critical topics like ocean protection, green innovation, and youth activism. The platform features reporting from environmental leaders and organizations working on conservation efforts worldwide.

## Key Topics

- Climate Change
- Wildlife Conservation
- Ocean Protection
- Sustainable Fashion
- Youth Activism
- Green Innovation
- Environmental Education
- Environmental News
- Earth.Org Kids
- Mangrove Protection
- Sea Turtle Conservation
- Sustainable Living
- The Earth Prize

## Kids & Youth Environmental News

- [Earth.Org Kids – Environmental News](https://kids.earth.org): Environmental news platform for youth on climate, wildlife, and sustainable living.
